intro.title: The Common Grounds Media Matrix
intro.text: A smooth, slide-based presentation comparing the two countries. It charts shared seafaring history, culinary crossovers and language links, and also covers family, faith, dress, crafts, architecture, music, celebrations and people.

ui.hint: Swipe, scroll or use the arrow keys

slides.title: Wedding Celebrations
slides.text: Weddings are family festivals. Both countries celebrate with a henna night, a bridal procession with drums and traditional chants (the zaffa in Bahrain), gifts between families, beautiful bridal gowns and a large feast with a roast lamb and sweets.
